name: Trade Agreement 15
definition: Date and identification of a trade together with references to previous events in its life.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date on which the trading parties agreed to amend or cancel the trade.

OriginatorReference.name: Originator Reference
OriginatorReference.definition: Reference of the present instruction assigned by the party issuing the message. This reference must be unique amongst all messages of same type sent by the same party.

MatchingSystemReference.name: Matching System Reference
MatchingSystemReference.definition: Identification of a matching system reference by a choice between a matching system unique identification or the related reference.

CommonReference.name: Common Reference
CommonReference.definition: Reference common to both parties of the trade.

AmendOrCancelReason.name: Amend Or Cancel Reason
AmendOrCancelReason.definition: Describes the reason for the cancellation or the amendment.

OperationType.name: Operation Type
OperationType.definition: Specifies the type of underlying transaction, for example cancellation (CANC).

OperationScope.name: Operation Scope
OperationScope.definition: Specifies the business role between the submitter and the trade party, for example Agent (AGNT).

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Specifies the product for which the status of the confirmation is reported.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS settlement session that the related trade is part of.

PaymentVersusPaymentIndicator.name: Payment Versus Payment Indicator
PaymentVersusPaymentIndicator.definition: Specifies if the FX transaction is PVP settlement. Payment versus payment (PvP) settlement arrangement allows for two currencies in a foreign exchange (FX) contract to exchange simultaneously on a central settlement platform to eliminate the settlement risk. To apply PvP, the two parties in the FX contract need to have a pre-agreement with the central settlement platform, for example, USD/MYR FX deals require both parties to have an agreement to settle via HK Interbank Clearing Ltd settlement platform.
